raw_text: Confirmed: MV True Confidence struck by Houthi ASBM in Gulf of Aden. Three crew killed — first fatalities from Red Sea shipping attacks. AIS data shows vessel was transiting at 12 knots without naval escort. Indian Navy INS Kolkata responded for casualty evacuation. This is a game-changer for maritime insurance and routing decisions. Expect more diversions around Cape of Good Hope.
